svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif

text.tspan: Multidimensional poverty is defined as being deprived
in a range of health, education and living standards
indicators. The MPI is a measure that combines the
prevalence and the intensity of multidimensional
poverty on a scale from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate
higher poverty. Estimates based on the most recent

tspan.tspan: A separate dataset is produced to monitor trends over

text.tspan: time. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the
closest year between 2014 and 2023 is shown instead.
